svg.text: Amu Darya and Syr Darya · 7,445 level-12 basins · adapted from the Water Flow Diagram method (waterflowdiagram.ch)
This diagram does not close, and is not made to — see the note beneath it.
Where the water comes from, and what is taken
22-year mean annual volumes over 965,725 km² (measured) against the 2022 hydrological year of recorded diversion (administered). 1 mm of width ≈ 1.04 km³/yr.

path.title: Evapotranspiration — 219 km³/yr (measured) TerraClimate actual evapotranspiration, 22 complete years

Climatic surplus — 93.3 km³/yr (derived) precipitation - evapotranspiration Not a renewable-resource figure: it neither routes water nor accounts for storage, glacier melt or inflow from outside the domain
Amu Darya diverted — 44.3 km³/yr (administered) 44.26 of a 55.23 limit, 80 per cent

Unaccounted difference — 35.2 km³/yr (derived) climatic surplus - recorded diversion A residual, not a resource. The runoff series puts the land-surface flux at 153.7 km3/yr, well above the surplus, which is how visible the model mismatch is at this scale.
Syr Darya diverted — 13.8 km³/yr (administered) 86 per cent of the established limit

rect.title: Amu Darya diversion ICWC/BWO, 2022 hydrological year

Not accounted for The difference between the climatic surplus and recorded diversion. It includes river outflow, wetland and delta losses, aquifer recharge, and the mismatch between two models on different grids. It is not spare water.
Syr Darya diversion ICWC/BWO, 2022 hydrological year

svg.text: Where Uzbekistan's Amu Darya water goes

Drawn at its own scale: these flows are twenty times smaller than those above. Sector shares are national, applied to one basin's diversion — proportions, not basin measurements. 1 mm of width ≈ 0.056 km³/yr.

path.title: Agriculture — 15.2 km³/yr (derived) 16.76 km3 x 90.5% National share of 90.5 per cent applied to the country's Amu Darya diversion. The share is national; the diversion is one basin. Treat the split as indicative of proportion, not as a basin measurement.
Collector-drainage reuse — 1.6 km³/yr (administered) Reused collector and drainage water, nationally

Municipal — 0.754 km³/yr (derived) 16.76 km3 x 4.5% National share of 4.5 per cent applied to the country's Amu Darya diversion. The share is national; the diversion is one basin. Treat the split as indicative of proportion, not as a basin measurement.

Industry — 0.235 km³/yr (derived) 16.76 km3 x 1.4% National share of 1.4 per cent applied to the country's Amu Darya diversion. The share is national; the diversion is one basin. Treat the split as indicative of proportion, not as a basin measurement.

Fisheries — 0.201 km³/yr (derived) 16.76 km3 x 1.2% National share of 1.2 per cent applied to the country's Amu Darya diversion. The share is national; the diversion is one basin. Treat the split as indicative of proportion, not as a basin measurement.

Other — 0.168 km³/yr (derived) 16.76 km3 x 1.0% National share of 1.0 per cent applied to the country's Amu Darya diversion. The share is national; the diversion is one basin. Treat the split as indicative of proportion, not as a basin measurement.
Treated wastewater return — 0.156 km³/yr (measured) 428,531 m3/d across 53 plants in 43 basins, 61.7 L/person/day. The one urban flow published in volume here.
Discharged to rivers — 0.156 km³/yr (measured) Outfalls located to level-12 basins

Thermal Power — 0.084 km³/yr (derived) 16.76 km3 x 0.5% National share of 0.5 per cent applied to the country's Amu Darya diversion. The share is national; the diversion is one basin. Treat the split as indicative of proportion, not as a basin measurement.

Distribution losses — not quantified (unquantified) Central to the method and often the largest single finding in its published applications. No baseline is published for this region: the 2023 national plan targets a 10 per cent reduction without stating what from.

Groundwater abstraction — not quantified (unquantified) The method separates surface from groundwater sources. National usable groundwater is given as 0.5 km3/yr against an estimated 27.6 km3/yr yield, but abstraction is not published at any scale this diagram can use.

Untreated wastewater — not quantified (unquantified) The inventory carries 53 plants and the volume they treat. What is generated and never reaches a plant is the quantity the method most wants and no source here reports.

rect.title: Uzbekistan use Sectoral shares are national and are applied here to the Amu Darya diversion only

Distribution losses Central to the method and often the largest single finding in its published applications. No baseline is published for this region: the 2023 national plan targets a 10 per cent reduction without stating what from.

Groundwater abstraction The method separates surface from groundwater sources. National usable groundwater is given as 0.5 km3/yr against an estimated 27.6 km3/yr yield, but abstraction is not published at any scale this diagram can use.
Untreated wastewater The inventory carries 53 plants and the volume they treat. What is generated and never reaches a plant is the quantity the method most wants and no source here reports.
Returned to rivers and the delta

svg.text: Returned to rivers and the delta 1.76
MeasuredThis project's observation record or plant inventory. Reproducible from the published release.
AdministeredPublished by the bodies that allocate the water. What was allocated and diverted, not an independent measurement of what flowed.
DerivedArithmetic on the above, with the operation stated on the flow.
Not quantifiedA flow the method expects and no source here supplies. Drawn as a gap rather than omitted, so its absence is visible.
Colour is how a flow is known, not what kind of water it is. Dashed hairlines are flows nobody has quantified — drawn at a fixed width so they are never read as small.
